optimizer: scipy.optimize.minimize SLSQP, one deterministic initial point per case
objective: minimize epigraph tau bounding max singular-value condition number of every element Jacobian at four corners and four 2x2 Gauss points
active_region: nodes of initial kappa>4 elements and two edge-neighbor element rings; fixed elsewhere
physical_boundary: all original nodes on x=0,1000 or y=0,600 fixed exactly
marked_region_protection: freeze all vertices of refined cells whose four original vertices lie in the union of original marked base quads
local_node_size: minimum original incident topological edge length h_i
candidate_selection: best feasible improving iterate from the single SLSQP trajectory including final point; optimizer success reported independently; no restart
termination: SLSQP termination or 200 iterations; no restart, no per-case tuning; infeasible or non-improving result rejected
safety: original topology/IDs/attributes fixed; physical boundary and protected nodes fixed; independent unchanged full geometry validator mandatory; no invalid candidate published as accepted
native_gate: fresh MAPDL model only for candidates passing original geometry thresholds; CHECK without changing native shape limits; P1 and pressure re-export; no SOLVE
